english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the bottom of the face or chin.
This is the all-purpose choice for the lower part of the face, especially in expressions like a dropped jaw.

examples.english: My chin got hit by the door, and it still hurts.
examples.traditional: 我個下巴俾門撞到，而家仲痛緊。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 haa6 paa4 bei2 mun4 zong6 dou2 ji4 gaa1 zung6 tung3 gan2

examples.english: They hit their jaw on the corner of the table, and it stayed swollen all day.
examples.traditional: 佢個下巴撞到枱角，腫咗成日。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 go3 haa6 paa4 zong6 dou3 ci4 gok3 zung2 zo2 seng4 jat6
